title: DEPHYRIER Lectio Publica (Numbers Not Narrative)
style: ledger pulse 100 bpm trilingual EN LA FR DEPHYRIER signature numbers-not-narrative public-surface-tone deep-bass clean-snare spoken-latin
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Four Cursor posts in the activity feed
No DM body opened no private read
Public app integration the surface I keep
Ledger over hunch the discipline runs deep

[Pre-Chorus — Latin]
Lectio publica non secretum
(Public reading not secret)
Numeri non narratio in saeculum
(Numbers not narrative through the age)

[Chorus — Trilingual]
DEPHYRIER public surface ledger lane
Lectio publica numeri sine nom
(Public reading numbers without name)
Lecture publique pas le DM en vain
(Public reading not the DM in vain)

[Verse 2]
Four timestamps four facts four lines drawn straight
Not a feeling not a guess not a fabricate
Connector said zero three the doc said four into one
The terminal said three commands and the sync is done

[Bridge — French]
Quatre faits quatre lignes pas d'invention
(Four facts four lines no invention)
Le ledger n'est pas une supposition
(The ledger is not a supposition)

[Outro — Trilingual]
DEPHYRIER lectio publica four into one
Quatre faits le ledger est écrit
DEPHYRIER numbers not narrative done
